title: SOC2 Control Mapping - draft notes
content:
Purpose:
Quick working draft for mapping Redwood controls to SOC2 criteria. Mostly notes-to-self and open questions for review with Ryan/Lena. Not polished.

Scope:
- Redwood hosted API + Dedicated runtime + Private deploy (customer-managed) - focus on controls we own (not customer-configured infra).
- Timebox: v1 evidence collection for readiness review on 2024-02-20.

High level mapping (brain dump):
- Logical access (AC): AWS IAM roles + Okta SSO + GitHub SAML. Evidence: IAM role list, Okta admin exports, SCIM user provisioning logs, GitHub org membership CSV. Owner: Ryan C.
- Change management (CM): PR/merge policy, CI/CD pipeline logs, release notes. Evidence: GitHub branch protection, Jenkins/GHA run history, rollout canary config in console. Owner: Oliver P.
- Incident response (IR): PagerDuty rotations, incident runbooks, postmortems. Evidence: PagerDuty schedule, 3 recent postmortems (Jan 2024), tabletop exercise notes. Owner: Lena M.
- Data encryption (EN): KMS usage, key rotation policy, TLS everywhere. Evidence: KMS CMK list, key policy doc, cert inventory. Owner: Samira A.
- Backup & recovery (DR): Snapshot schedule, restore test results. Evidence: RDS snapshot policy, S3 backup bucket lifecycle, last recovery drill (2023-11-02). Owner: infra team (need point).
- Vendor management (VG): Third-party contracts (Datadog, PagerDuty, Okta), security questionnaires. Evidence: Signed contracts + security attestation. Owner: legal/security ops.
- Monitoring & logging (MON): Centralized logs (ELK/Cloudwatch), retention, alerting thresholds. Evidence: Logging architecture diagram, retention settings, alert runbooks. Owner: observability team.

Open questions / gaps I can think of:
- Evidence storage: where to put artifacts for auditor? Confluence? Shared drive? Security wants single index page. (ask @Lena)
- Access review cadence: do we have documented quarterly reviews for GitHub/Okta? I think Github org monthly, Okta quarterly - confirm.
- Automated evidence exports: can we script exports for IAM and billing? If yes, reduce manual pack. (ticket to infra)
- Private deploy customers: some evidence will be customer-managed (network, KMS). Need a template that says "customer-owned controls" and what we attest to.
- Formal policy docs: we have some high-level policies (access, encryption) but not always signed/dated. Need to produce brief sign-off doc.

Rough list of artifacts to collect (short checklist):
- [ ] IAM role list export (CSV) + recent access review doc
- [ ] Okta admin report + SCIM provisioning logs
- [ ] GitHub org membership + 6-months audit log excerpt
- [ ] KMS key inventory + rotation policy doc
- [ ] TLS cert inventory + cert manager configs
- [ ] CD pipeline run logs for last 3 major releases
- [ ] PR protection config screenshots
- [ ] PagerDuty schedule + 3 incident postmortems (redacted)
- [ ] Backup schedules + latest restore test evidence
- [ ] Vendor contract list + security questionnaires
- [ ] Logging retention settings + example alert history

Next steps / meeting plan:
- Sync with Ryan/Lena/Oliver: quick 30m to align owners and confirm artifact locations (target: 2024-02-05).
- Create Confluence "SOC2 evidence index" page with links to each artifact and owner contact. (I will start skeleton).
- Open JIRA-SEC epic to track artifact collection + remediation tasks. Link: JIRA-SEC-987.
- Draft the auditor-facing control mapping table (CSV) mapping SOC2 criterium -> our control -> evidence link -> owner -> status.

Notes to self (low priority / later):
- Need to redline some runbooks to remove PII before sharing with auditors.
- Consider automated monthly snapshot of evidence into secure S3 (read-only for auditors).
- Validate that Dedicated instances have isolated logging buckets per customer (some customers require separation).

Slack/PR refs:
- Slack thread: #sec-soc2-prep (see pinned messages, last thread 2024-01-25)
- GitHub PR: infra/pull/213 (changes to backup script)
- Confluence: CONF-SEC-4321 (control definitions page)

- Ryan: export Okta/GitHub reports + confirm access review cadence (due 2024-01-26)
- Oliver: collect CD logs + PR protection screenshots (due 2024-01-26)
- Lena: pull PagerDuty schedules + postmortems redaction guidance (due 2024-01-26)

Quick comments: keep this doc as working notes. Will convert to a formal control mapping spreadsheet once owners confirm.
